en.t: It has been almost an hour and a half.

units.source_text: 做记录的少女回答时，正午的汽笛嘶鸣了。

en.t: As the girl keeping the record answered, the noon whistle shrieked.

units.source_text: 少女用她拿手的报秒法，估计着汽笛长鸣的时间。

en.t: Using her practiced method of calling out the seconds, the girl estimated how long the whistle kept sounding.
